title: 第21章 准备复仇第22章 找上苏冰
slug: 觉醒阴阳神功分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
宋萌萌见状，连忙伸手抓住他的手腕，语气急切：“陈阳，这么晚了，你要到哪里去住？你头上还有伤，我跟李恒都不放心你。
我那里还有空房，就随便睡一个晚上，没事的。
你要是实在不好意思，那我先跟李恒打个电话，问问他的意思。”
陈阳看着宋萌萌真诚的眼神，又想起自己头上的伤，实在拗不过她，只好把车门关了回去，语气无奈：“嫂子，那你先跟恒哥说一声吧，别让他误会。”
宋萌萌脸上露出笑容，连忙将车子靠边停下，拿出手机正要拨通李恒的电话，手机却先一步响了起来。
碎掉的屏幕上赫然显示着“李恒”两个字。
她连忙接通电话。
李恒焦急又激动的声音就从电话那头传了过来：“萌萌，阳子没事吧？这么晚了，你们还在外面吗？我都快急死了！”
宋萌萌连忙安抚道：“恒哥，你别担心，陈阳没事，我们快到小区门口了。
不过陈阳他执意要回去，我叫不住他，要不你跟他说一下，让他先在我们这里住一晚，这么晚了，他一个人回去我们也不放心。”
说着，她把手机递到陈阳面前。
陈阳接过手机，放到耳边，就听到李恒急切的声音：“阳子，你没事吧？有没有受伤？”
陈阳心中一暖，语气轻松：“恒哥，我没事，一点伤都没有。
现在太晚了，我就不打扰你跟嫂子了，我准备打车回去了。”
李恒的语气瞬间严肃起来，带着不容拒绝的强硬：“这么晚了还回去干嘛？我这里又不是没有房间，你赶紧给我上来，我就在电梯口等你，快点，别废话！”
话音刚落，李恒就直接挂了电话。
陈阳无奈地摇了摇头，把手机递回给宋萌萌。
宋萌萌笑着看着他，语气带着几分得意：“陈阳，还回去不？我就说恒哥也不会让你回去的。”
陈阳轻轻摇了摇头，语气无奈又带着暖意：“不回了，那就在你们家睡一晚吧，麻烦你们了。”
宋萌萌笑了起来，语气轻快：“这有什么麻烦的？你跟李恒从小一起长大，跟亲兄弟一样。

对了，你跟李恒身材差不多，他有的是衣服，我听他说，你们以前都经常穿同一条底裤……”
陈阳脸上露出几分尴尬，没有多说什么，只是轻轻点了点头。
宋萌萌不再打趣他，发动车子，缓缓驶入小区地下停车场，找了个空位停好车。
两人一同下车，宋萌萌下意识地伸手扶着陈阳的胳膊，朝着电梯口走去。
陈阳连忙说：“嫂子，我自己就行，不用扶我，我没事。”
宋萌萌却没有松手，语气关切：“没事，你别嫌弃，你头上还有伤呢，小心点好。”
两人走进电梯，宋萌萌按下11楼的按钮。
电梯缓缓上升，车厢里很安静，只有电梯运行的轻微声响。
很快，电梯就到了11楼，门缓缓打开。
出了电梯，就见李恒站在电梯门前等候。
content_en:
Seeing this, Song Mengmeng quickly stretched out her hand to grab his wrist and said in an urgent tone: "Chen Yang, it's so late, where are you going to stay? You still have injuries on your head, and Li Heng and I don't trust you.
I still have a vacant room there, so I can just sleep there for one night, it'll be fine.
If you are really embarrassed, then I will call Li Heng first and ask him what he means. "
Chen Yang looked at Song Mengmeng's sincere eyes and remembered the injury on his head. He couldn't resist her, so he had to close the car door and said in a helpless tone: "Sister-in-law, tell Brother Heng first, don't let him misunderstand."
With a smile on her face, Song Mengmeng quickly pulled over the car, took out her cell phone and was about to dial Li Heng's number, but her cell phone rang first.
The word "Li Heng" was clearly displayed on the broken screen.
She quickly answered the phone.
Li Heng's anxious and excited voice came from the other end of the phone: "Mengmeng, is Yangzi okay? It's so late, are you still out? I'm almost dying!"
Song Mengmeng quickly comforted him: "Brother Heng, don't worry, Chen Yang is fine, we are almost at the gate of the community.
But Chen Yang insists on going back, and I can't stop him. Why don't you tell him and let him stay with us for one night first. It's so late, and we don't feel comfortable if he goes back alone. "
With that said, she handed the phone to Chen Yang.
Chen Yang took the phone and put it to his ear, and heard Li Heng's urgent voice: "Yangzi, are you okay? Are you injured?"
Chen Yang felt warm in his heart and said in a relaxed tone: "Brother Heng, I'm fine, I'm not hurt at all.
It's too late now, so I won't disturb you and my sister-in-law. I'm going to take a taxi back. "
Li Heng's tone suddenly became serious, with a toughness that could not be refused: "Why are you going back so late? It's not like I don't have a room here. Come up here quickly. I'll wait for you at the elevator entrance. Come on, don't talk nonsense!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Li Heng hung up the phone.
Chen Yang shook his head helplessly and handed the phone back to Song Mengmeng.
Song Mengmeng looked at him with a smile, and her tone was a bit proud: "Chen Yang, are you going back? I said Brother Heng won't let you go back either."
Chen Yang shook his head gently, and his tone was helpless and warm: "If I'm not going back, then I'll sleep at your house for one night. I'm sorry to bother you."
Song Mengmeng laughed and said in a brisk tone: "What's the trouble? You and Li Heng grew up together, just like brothers.
By the way, you and Li Heng have similar figures. He has a lot of clothes. I heard from him that you both used to wear the same pair of underwear..."
Chen Yang showed a bit of embarrassment on his face. He didn't say anything more and just nodded lightly.
Song Mengmeng stopped teasing him, started the car, slowly drove into the underground parking lot of the community, found an empty space and parked the car.
The two got off the car together. Song Mengmeng subconsciously reached out to hold Chen Yang's arm and walked towards the elevator entrance.
Chen Yang quickly said: "Sister-in-law, I can do it by myself, no need to help me, I'm fine."
Song Mengmeng did not let go, and said in a concerned tone: "It's okay, don't dislike it, you still have a wound on your head, be careful."
The two walked into the elevator and Song Mengmeng pressed the button for the 11th floor.
The elevator rose slowly, and the carriage was very quiet, with only the slight sound of the elevator running.
Soon, the elevator reached the 11th floor and the door slowly opened.
When they got out of the elevator, they saw Li Heng waiting in front of the elevator door.
